_about: How each traded 2027 NBA first-rounder lands once the lottery sets the order, from RealGM's detailed pick list (read Nov 3, 2026). Applied in this order by the mock draft. to: the pick goes to `to` unless it lands in `keep`, then the original team keeps it. split: a range decides the receiver. swap: `holder` takes the better of its pick and `with`'s. favorable: the picks in `picks`, best first, go to `to` in order; a pick in its `bar` range stays home and its team drops out of `to`; if the last one lands in `lastKeep`, it goes to `fallback`. okc: Oklahoma City swaps the worse of its pick and Denver's for the Clippers' if that's better, then the Clippers swap whatever they hold for Toronto's if that's better. Second-round picks keep the owner Tankathon shows today.

first.note: Houston can swap its pick for Brooklyn's
OKC can swap its pick or Denver's for the Clippers'; the Clippers can then swap for Toronto's
Picks 1-16 to Sacramento, 17-30 to Oklahoma City
New Orleans takes the better of its and Milwaukee's; Atlanta the other, top-4 protected
Memphis takes the best of Utah's (unless top 5), Cleveland's and Minnesota's; Utah the next, Phoenix the last

lottery.note: The 3-2-1 lottery, new for 2027: 16 teams, every one of the 16 picks drawn. Balls: 2 each for the three worst records, 3 each for the next seven non-play-in teams, 2 each for the 9 and 10 seeds, 1 each for the teams that lose the 7-8 play-in games. The worst teams can fall no lower than 12. No team wins No. 1 two years running (Washington won it in 2026) or a top-five pick three years running (Utah was top five in 2025 and 2026); both follow the original team's pick. Picks 17-30 go by record, and the first 16 second-rounders mirror the first round.
